trajectory.thought: The leader is a seeded baseline (DBA) and the verdict is "indistinguishable" — the runner-up is not statistically better. With unstable ranking (Kendall τ=0.064), high error correlation (0.768), and only 3 validation windows, any fitted weighting or subset selection would chase noise. DBA's robust aggregation is well-suited to this series's strong trend + seasonality with no reliable model dominance.

action_args.justification: The series has a strong upward trend (0.99) and strong 12-month seasonality (0.71), making it highly predictable but non-stationary. Model ranking is unstable across the 3 validation windows (Kendall τ=0.064) and error correlation is high (mean 0.768, only 2 independent groups), so no subset or fitted weighting can be trusted to generalize. DBA (DTW barycenter) is a robust aggregation that respects the shape of each forecast without chasing window-specific noise, which is the right kind of combination when the ranking does not hold and most models carry correlated error. The runner-up margin (0.026) is not statistically distinguishable, confirming that further tuning would not yield a reliable gain.
